newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar but was weaker versus the pound at Tuesday's fixing, forex dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a mean commercial rate of 20.023 against the dollar from 20.031 on Monday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean rate of 32.6975 from 32.5580 on Monday.
Despite central bank intervention in the interbank market on Monday, dealers said the rupee's fixing on Tuesday was mainly influenced by the dollar's trend in overnight international markets.

"The central bank interventions are not really appreciating the rupee as they did during the past few months. It's rather that they (interventions) are having a stabilising effect now," one dealer said.

The central bank was seen selling dollars during Monday's early afternoon intervention at 19.98 rupees per dollar. Forex dealers said such intervention rate was "within the range of the interbank rate."
